title: 2202. Maximize the Topmost Element After K Moves

examples.explanation: One of the ways we can end with 5 at the top of the pile after 4 moves is as follows: - Step 1: Remove the topmost element = 5. The pile becomes [2,2,4,0,6]. - Step 2: Remove the topmost element = 2. The pile becomes [2,4,0,6]. - Step 3: Remove the topmost element = 2. The pile becomes [4,0,6]. - Step 4: Add 5 back onto the pile. The pile becomes [5,4,0,6]. Note that this is not the only way to end with 5 at the top of the pile. It can be shown that 5 is the largest answer possible after 4 moves.
In the first move, our only option is to pop the topmost element of the pile. Since it is not possible to obtain a non-empty pile after one move, we return -1.
